text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis (PSC)

Given your confirmed history of ulcerative colitis, the elevated alkaline phosphatase, and the ultrasound showing bile duct thickening, the combination of these factors strongly points to PSC. The ultrasound findings of a "beaded" or irregular duct pattern would confirm this, so I am requesting specific MRCP images to finalize the workup.
